Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This website enables users to create property listings with the assistance of AI.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.text: The person responsible for processing data on this website is:

processedData.title: 2. Data processed
processedData.text: Personal data may be processed when visiting and using this website. This includes, in particular, names, email addresses, telephone numbers, login details and information entered through forms.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
purpose.text: The data is used to provide Inserat-AI’s functions, manage user accounts, respond to enquiries, generate property listings and operate the website securely and reliably.

aiContent.title: 4. AI-generated content
aiContent.text: Information entered to create property listings may be transmitted to an AI service for text generation. Confidential or particularly sensitive data should not be entered.

contactForm.title: 5. Contact form
contactForm.text: When you contact us through a form, we use the information provided to process your enquiry and respond to any follow-up questions.

storage.title: 6. Storage and security
storage.text: Personal data is stored only for as long as required for the relevant purpose or by statutory retention obligations. We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect the data.

thirdParties.title: 7. Disclosure to third parties
thirdParties.text: Data may be disclosed to technical service providers where this is necessary to operate the website, provide its functions or process payments.

rights.title: 8. Rights of data subjects
rights.text: Data subjects may request information about their stored data and, where applicable, request its correction or deletion. Requests may be sent to info@inserat-ai.ch.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.text: We may amend this Privacy Policy at any time. The version published on this website applies.

custom.title: Describe the furnishing
custom.label: How should the room be furnished?
custom.placeholder: For example: light beige sofa, round wooden table, warm lighting, a few plants and no rugs.

examplesText.warm: Light sofa, round wooden table, warm lighting and a few plants.
examplesText.bold: Dark leather sofa, black metal table, restrained artwork and no rugs.
examplesText.natural: Natural wood, light fabrics, subtle plants and very little decoration.

diningRoom.label: Dining room

preview.title: Quick preview
preview.description: Quickly check how style, furniture and colours work
preview.notice: Quick mode active: suitable for testing and comparing.

final.title: Final marketing image
final.description: Higher quality for listings, brochures and social media
final.notice: Final mode active: takes longer but provides more detail and a larger output.

generation.preservation: The AI should only add movable furniture and decoration. Structural features must remain unchanged.

progress.title: Visualising the room
progress.description: The AI is analysing perspective, geometry and existing room elements. This may take some time.
progress.finalizing: The visible image is being refined in the background until the final preview is ready.

status.previewCreated: The preview was created and has not been saved yet.
status.saved: The AI visualisation was permanently saved with the property.
status.partialReady: First preview after {seconds} seconds. The final image is still being refined.
status.previewCreatedWithTime: Final preview after {seconds} seconds. It has not been saved yet.

result.title: Original and AI result
result.saveDescription: The original remains available. The AI version is linked separately to this property and source image.
result.partialNotApplied: The final image is still being refined
